_comment: Business Central -> GLAccount pull-sync config. Maps the BC 'accounts' object (general-ledger accounts) onto MJ_BizApps_Accounting: GL Accounts via the integration engine. Authored ACTIVE: `mj sync push` creates this CompanyIntegration, its entity/field maps, and (from the sibling dir) the nightly job. The one remaining per-environment step is credentials -- attach an MJ: Credentials record (CredentialType business-central-oauth2) via CredentialID and set the target company (CompanyID / env BIZAPPS_ACCOUNTING_COMPANY_ID). Until a credential is wired, each sync run completes QUIETLY as Success with 0 records: the missing-credential error throws inside FetchChanges on the first page, which the engine records as a Warning (not a failure), so the run is not marked failed and NotifyOnFailure does not fire -- the error appears only in the run's ErrorLog.

fields.Name: BizApps Accounting - Business Central GL Account Sync
fields.Configuration: {"note":"Pull-only. Fetches BC general-ledger accounts and upserts GL Accounts keyed on ExternalAccountID. Nightly at 02:00 UTC via the erp-account-sync-schedule scheduled job; these Schedule* fields mirror that job for display."}

MJ: Company Integration Entity Maps._comment: accounts (BC general-ledger accounts, read-only) -> GL Accounts, Pull. Dedup is driven by the IsKeyField=true ExternalAccountID field map + the engine's Record Map.

MJ: Company Integration Field Maps._comment: BC account id (SystemId GUID) -> ExternalAccountID. Stored for reference/traceability; NOT a match key. Matching is on (Code, CompanyID) so BC accounts UPSERT onto the pre-seeded chart (whose rows have no ExternalAccountID); the first sync adopts each seeded row and writes this id onto it. Key fields are AND-ed, so making this a key field would exclude the seeded rows (null ExternalAccountID) and re-introduce the insert collision.

BC account number -> Code. KEY FIELD (with CompanyID): matches an existing GLAccount by (Code, CompanyID) so BC accounts UPSERT onto the seeded chart instead of colliding on UQ_GLAccount_CompanyID_Code.

BC account category -> AccountType. BC's OData API encodes option-set captions (_x0020_=space, _x002D_=hyphen, ...), so a decode step runs BEFORE the lookup - otherwise 'Cost of Goods Sold' arrives as 'Cost_x0020_of_x0020_Goods_x0020_Sold' and misses the map. There is NO source filter excluding structural heading/total rows: the BC connector's FetchChanges pulls the whole 'accounts' collection and ignores entity-map query params, so every row whose category is blank (heading/total rows, plus any un-categorized posting account) is fetched, falls to Default=null, and FAILS the AccountType NOT NULL insert per-record (that row is dead-lettered and the run is marked Failed; the other accounts sync). See README.
BC account blocked -> IsActive (negated). blocked=true means the account is blocked from posting, i.e. inactive.
Constant -> ExternalSystem. SourceFieldName is a sentinel absent from BC records; the custom transform emits the literal regardless of input.

Constant -> CompanyID (NOT NULL FK). WIRING-TIME VALUE: replace the placeholder UUID below with the target __mj.Company ID (must equal BIZAPPS_ACCOUNTING_COMPANY_ID used on the CompanyIntegration). @env cannot resolve inside this transform JSON, so it is a literal placeholder by design.
